guard/30076.htm.text: Guard Liam: If you follow the road that lies before me to the east, you can easily arrive at the Bazaar of Giran. One thing you must remember is to be on your guard when you pass the Execution Grounds, about halfway there. That place is crawling with evil undead. May the divine protection of Einhas…

links.text: Ask about the Bazaar of Giran.
Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30076-1.htm.text: Guard Liam: I myself have never been to the Bazaar of Giran. However, our village frequently trades with the Bazaar, so I know a little about what it is like there. It is a place where there are all sorts of priceless items. If you can't find it there, then you won't be able to find it anywhere in …

guard/30076-2.htm.text: Guard Liam: It is risky to speak of such things, but I will trust you and tell you. It is the Execution Grounds of a rebel army of farmers who revolted against the lord's severe rule a few years ago. At the time, the lord cruelly and publicly executed all those involved in the revolt, and their fam…

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30076-01.htm.text: Listto: Hmm... I haven't seen anyone like that. You can try asking Sabuh over there. Hey Sabuh! There's someone here with a question for ya.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30076-01a.ht.text: Listto: I haven't seen anyone like that. You can try asking Sabuh over there. Hey Sabuh! There's someone here with a question for ya.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30076-02.htm.text: Listto: What do you want? Hmm, someone who fits that description went by here a little while ago. Looked like he was rushing to get to Giran. He didn't cause any trouble, so we let him pass. If you take this road, you'll arrive at the Giran North Gate. Ask Zerome about him when you get there.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30076-03.htm.text: Listto: Didn't I already tell ya? Someone who fits that description headed toward Giran a little while ago. If you take this road, you'll arrive at the Giran North Gate. There you can ask Zerome or Besa about him.
